name: Power Plant Worker — "If you control creatures named Mine Worker and Tower Worker" is read by name
notes: Memory: project_audit_target_changes_nothing_2026-10-11. "This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control creatures named Mine Worker and Tower Worker, put two +1/+1 counters on this creature instead." The condition was read as merely "you control creatures". _parseCondition now reads "you control [a / N or more / exactly N] <type>(s) named A [and B]" by name, so with both other Workers out the +2/+2 does not apply (the counters are the player's to add); alone it does (see the instead-with-counters recipe).
